28/* @brief Joint-space PD controller parameters. */
29struct ControllerBasicJscPdParams {
30 // joint space gains
31 DynamicArray<real> Kp = {}; // The position gain [Nm/rad]
32 DynamicArray<real> Kd = {}; // The position damping gain [Nms/rad]
33
34 // The saturation magnitude of the controller output for each joint.
35 // Values < 0 are interpreted as infinitiy
36 DynamicArray<real> saturation = {}; // [N or Nm]
37
38 // The deadband is removed from error towards 0 (limited to 0) before multiplying by Kp.
39 // Damping is always applied regardless of the deadband.
40 // The deadband results in a force profile about the target like this \___/ rather than \/
41 DynamicArray<real> deadband = {};
42
43 /**
44 * @brief Load controller parameters from a JSON file.
45 * @param[in] path Path to a .superdex_controller JSON file.
46 * @param[in,out] error Error status.
47 * @return Loaded parameters, or default-constructed on failure.
48 */
49 static MOCHI_API ControllerBasicJscPdParams
50 LoadFromFile(std::string_view path, superdex::Error& error);
51
52 /**
53 * @brief Save controller parameters to a JSON file.
54 * @param[in] path Destination file path.
55 * @param[in,out] error Error status.
56 */
57 MOCHI_API void SaveToFile(std::string_view path, superdex::Error& error) const;
58
59 MOCHI_STRUCT_BEGIN(superdex::robotics::ControllerBasicJscPdParams)
60 MOCHI_FIELD(Kp) MOCHI_ATTRIBUTE(Units("N/m or Nm/rad"));
61 MOCHI_FIELD(Kd) MOCHI_ATTRIBUTE(Units("Ns/m or Nms/rad"));
62 MOCHI_FIELD(saturation) MOCHI_ATTRIBUTE(Units("N or Nm"));
63 MOCHI_FIELD(deadband) MOCHI_ATTRIBUTE(Units("m or rad"));
64 MOCHI_STRUCT_END()
65};

67/* @brief Observation state — robot state variables read each control step.
68 * Fill it with GetCurrentObservationsFromMochi to read the live simulation, or populate it
69 * directly from an external state source (e.g., a real robot). */
70struct ControllerBasicJscPdObsv {
71 DynamicArray<real> dofPositions; /* All DOF positions [rad or m] */
72 DynamicArray<real> dofVelocities; /* All DOF velocities [rad/s or m/s] */
73 real dt = 0_r; /* Time since the last ComputeOutput call [s] */
74};
75
76/* @brief Target setpoint for the controller. */
77struct ControllerBasicJscPdTarget {
78 DynamicArray<real> targetPose; /* Target joint positions [m or rad] */
79};

81/* @brief A simple PD controller written in joint space. */
82
83// NOLINTNEXTLINE(cppcoreguidelines-virtual-class-destructor)
84class MOCHI_API ControllerBasicJscPd : public ControllerBase {
85 public:
86 /* @brief Registration type name for this controller (see
87 * RoboticsContext::RegisterControllerType).
88 * @return This controller's registration type name. */
89 static constexpr std::string_view TypeName() {
90 return "BASIC_JSC_PD";
91 }
92
93 [[nodiscard]] std::string_view GetTypeName() const override {
94 return TypeName();
95 }
96
97 using Params = ControllerBasicJscPdParams;
98 using Obsv = ControllerBasicJscPdObsv;
99 using Target = ControllerBasicJscPdTarget;
100
101 /* @brief Construct a joint-space PD controller for the given articulated robot, optionally
102 * holding a borrowed robot-model description (see GetBotPrefab).
103 * @param prefab Optional borrowed BotPrefab model (may be null; must outlive the controller).
104 * @param robot The articulated robot actor to control.
105 * @param error Error status. */
106 ControllerBasicJscPd(BotPrefab const* prefab, Actor* robot, superdex::Error& error);
107
108 /* @brief No-op initialization for pattern consistency with OSC.
109 * JSC requires no link resolution; params are set via SetParams(). */
110 void Initialize(superdex::Error& /*error*/) {}
111
112 /* @brief Get controller parameters.
113 * @return Reference to parameters. */
114 Params const& GetParams() const;
115
116 /* @brief Set controller parameters.
117 * @param params New parameters.
118 * @param error Error status. */
119 void SetParams(Params const& params, superdex::Error& error);
120
121 /* @brief Configure from a scene-file controller entry (loads params; needs no init args).
122 * Override of ControllerBase. */
123 void ConfigureFromSceneEntry(
124 std::string_view paramArgs,
125 std::string_view initArgs,
126 superdex::Error& error) override;
127
128 /* @brief Read current robot state from the Mochi actor.
129 * @param error Error status.
130 * @return Observation struct populated from the actor's current state. */
131 Obsv GetCurrentObservationsFromMochi(superdex::Error& error);
132
133 /* @brief Compute PD control efforts from observation state and target setpoint.
134 * @param obsv Current robot state (positions, velocities, dt).
135 * @param target Target setpoint.
136 * @param error Error status.
137 * @return Efforts for all DOFs [N or Nm]. Returns empty span on error. */
138 Span<real const> ComputeOutput(Obsv const& obsv, Target const& target, superdex::Error& error);
139
140 /* @brief Reset internal controller state (e.g., between episodes). */
141 void Reset() override;
142
143 protected:
144 void CheckParams(Params const& params, superdex::Error& error);
145
146 /* The controller parameters */
147 Params _params;
148
149 /* The efforts to be applied */
150 ColumnVector<real> _efforts;
151
152 /* The prior ComputeOutput call targetPose are stored here for computing target velocity */
153 DynamicArray<real> _prevTargetPose;
154 bool _prevTargetPoseInitialized = false;
155
156 ~ControllerBasicJscPd() override = default;
157};
